name: Redesign webu pro pitch
description: Boss si sám vyzkoumá odborníky, návštěvníky a lídry oboru, vytvoří vkus + scorecard, přepracuje web a testuje v prohlížeči.
focus: Deliverable: a redesigned website (or landing page) whose job is to land a pitch. Research must cover (1) experts on conversion/UX/copy for this kind of page and field, (2) what visitors of this field reward or punish, (3) the top 5-8 leader sites of the field with desktop+mobile screenshots. The scorecard must include: first-screen clarity in 5 seconds, positioning and proof, CTA, trust signals, mobile, performance, accessibility basics, brand/logo consistency, no placeholder content, SEO/meta basics.
